description: Perfiles Viales del Distrito de Barranquilla is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía Distrital de Barranquilla, Atlántico. Coverage: Alcaldía Distrital de Barranquilla, Atlántico. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía Distrital de Barranquilla, Atlántico. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ordenamiento Territorial. The portal shows 2021-12-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
